使用时，先把手机APP打开，和防丢设备进行配对，如把小防丢器和钥匙挂在一起时，用户要寻找钥匙，只需要点按手机的APP 报警功能，防丢器就会发出响声，相反当要寻找手机时，也只需要点击防丢器上的按钮，手机会发出响声
当两者的蓝牙连接断开时（距离远）手机和防丢器均会报警，从而达到双向防丢的功能

同时该APP还附加有拍照，录相和地图定位功能，同时通过设置还可以支持会议录音（录音时不能取到防丢功能），是居家旅游的一个好伴侣


该APP同时支持iPAD设备，在iPAD设备上可以直接下载使用

该APP目前只支持兰牙4.0设备，在同一时刻只能对一个防丢器进行双向管理，用户手机为iphone4s以上

Doglo is a GPS-GSM dog tracker. With Doglo device, it is very convenient to keep your dog or even livestock under control. A pet is never lost when he has a Doglo!

The Doglo app helps you manage your dog's smart device and get information about its activities.

*** Main features of Doglo app ***
* The location of the device in tracking mode is shown on two different Google base maps.
* On the map it is possible to view the history of the pet’s movement and traveled distance.
* You can use the ruler function to measure distances on a map.
* The user can have an unlimited number of tracking devices interfaced to the app.
* The user can configure the device's operation in the app (tracking or standby, monitoring interval, etc.).
* You can share your tracking device with 4 more users.
* You can store your points of interest on the map.

*** Doglo GPS-GSM smart device ***
The Doglo device provides a very accurate GPS position of the dog in the terrain. The tracking device uses the mobile network and has no distance limitation - the dog can be tracked from thousands of kilometers away. All you need is a smartphone to monitor your dog and control your device. 

In addition to tracking, you can call the dog, listen to the dog's activities and give voice commands.

Keeping the device constantly on the dog's neck, it acts as a security device and can be switched on from a distance when the dog is lost. 
 
The tracking device is very strong, lightweight, waterproof and has a long service life. The monitoring time is 36 hours (10 seconds interval) and the standby time is 1 month. In order to ensure waterproofing, there are no openings or buttons on the unit, and the 3 indicator lights indicate the unit's operating status. The device is charged wirelessly.

You can get your Doglo tracker in website doglo.eu
